title: Tailwise Autoship Shipments and the Unit Refund Value on Error Returns
content:
**Loyalty team note - error-return refunds on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders.**

The unit refund value on an error-return refund depends on the Tailwise Autoship shipments charged to the customer in the last 12 months - the shipment charge entries on any of the customer's Tailwise Autoship subscriptions, dated fewer than 12 whole months before today.

| Tailwise Autoship shipments charged in the last 12 months | Unit refund value |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | The unit list price on the line charge; the allocated coupon and certificate are not taken back |
| At least 1 but fewer than 6 | The unit price paid plus half of the coupon and certificate allocated per unit charged, rounded half up to the cent |
| None | No change under this note |

### Terms

- **Unit price paid** - the amount billed on the order's line charges divided by the units charged on them, rounded half up to the cent.
- **Unit list price** - the unit price shown on the order's line charge (where the order carries more than one line charge, the highest of their unit prices).
- **Coupon and certificate allocated per unit charged** - the coupon and certificate amounts allocated on the order's line charges, added together and divided by the units charged on them.

### Worked example (hypothetical line)

A hypothetical line charge of 3 units at a unit price of $19.99 carries a $3.00 coupon and a $2.00 certificate, so it was billed $54.97.

| Autoship shipments in 12 months | Unit refund value |
|---|---|
| 8 | $19.99 |
| 3 | Unit price paid $54.97 divided by 3, that is $18.32; plus half of $5.00 divided by 3, that is $0.8333...; $19.1533... rounds to $19.15 |
| 0 | No change under this note |

The threshold count belongs to the higher band: 6 shipments take the list price, 5 take the half-discount value, 1 takes the half-discount value.
